lessons.title: Polite Requests

items.example: Potrebbe per favore ripetere? Non ho sentito bene.
items.exampleMeaning: Could you please repeat? I couldn't hear well.

items.example: Per favore, aspetti un momento.
items.exampleMeaning: Please wait a moment.

items.example: Mi scusi se disturbo, ma ho una domanda.
items.exampleMeaning: Excuse me if I'm disturbing, but I have a question.

items.meaning: I would like to speak with...
items.example: Vorrei parlare con il signor Rossi.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to speak with Mr. Rossi.

items.meaning: Is it possible to speak with...?
items.example: È possibile parlare con la signora Bianchi?
items.exampleMeaning: Is it possible to speak with Mrs. Bianchi?

items.example: Mi può dire se è disponibile?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you tell me if he is available?

lessons.tip: Use 'Può' for formal requests and 'Puoi' for informal ones. Remember to use 'per favore' for politeness.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mi scusi, posso parlare con Marco?
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, can I speak with Marco?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry, he is not available.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Può aiutarmi a lasciargli un messaggio?
dialogue.meaning: Can you help me leave him a message?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Of course! What is the message?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Vorrei dire che richiamo più tardi.
dialogue.meaning: I would like to say that I will call back later.

scenario.learnerRole: You are calling to speak with Marco.
scenario.brief: Ask for Marco and leave a message if he is not available.
scenario.goal: You need to leave a message for Marco.

lessons.title: Spelling Names

items.example: Come si scrive il tuo nome?
items.exampleMeaning: How do you spell your name?

items.example: Il mio nome è Anna.
items.exampleMeaning: My name is Anna.

items.example: Può ripetere il suo nome?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you repeat your name?

items.example: Scusi, non ho capito il suo nome.
items.exampleMeaning: Sorry, I didn't understand your name.

items.example: Grazie per l'aiuto con il mio messaggio.
items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for your help with my message.

items.example: Posso avere il suo nome, per favore?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I have your name, please?

lessons.tip: When asking for spelling, use 'Come si scrive...?'. It’s a polite way to ask for clarification.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Posso avere il suo nome, per favore?
dialogue.meaning: Can I have your name, please?

scenario.learnerRole: You are giving your name to the receptionist.
scenario.brief: Provide your name and spell it out if needed.
scenario.goal: You need to successfully spell your name.

lessons.title: Taking a Message

items.example: Posso prendere un messaggio per Marco?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I take a message for Marco?

items.example: Quando torna il dottore?
items.exampleMeaning: When does the doctor return?

items.example: Può chiamare più tardi, per favore?
items.exampleMeaning: Can he call back later, please?

items.example: Grazie per l'informazione sul dottore.
items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for the information about the doctor.

items.example: Mi dispiace, non è qui adesso.
items.exampleMeaning: I'm sorry, he is not here now.

items.meaning: I will leave a message for him.
items.example: Le lascio un messaggio importante.
items.exampleMeaning: I will leave an important message for him.

lessons.tip: Use 'Posso prendere un messaggio?' when you need to take a message. It’s a polite way to ask.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Posso prendere un messaggio per Marco?
dialogue.meaning: Can I take a message for Marco?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I will leave a message for him.

scenario.learnerRole: You are speaking to the receptionist.
scenario.brief: Leave a message for Marco and ask when he will return.
scenario.goal: You need to leave a message for Marco.

lessons.title: Leaving a Message

items.example: Può dirgli che ho chiamato?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you tell him that I called?

items.meaning: I need to speak with him.
items.example: Ho bisogno di parlarle urgentemente.
items.exampleMeaning: I need to speak with him urgently.

items.example: Il mio numero è 123456789.
items.exampleMeaning: My number is 123456789.

items.example: Mi chiami quando può, per favore.
items.exampleMeaning: Call me when you can, please.

items.example: La ringrazio per l'aiuto.
items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for your help.

items.meaning: I am waiting for your call.
items.example: Aspetto una sua chiamata domani.
items.exampleMeaning: I am waiting for your call tomorrow.

lessons.tip: When leaving a message, use 'Può dirgli che...' to pass on information. It's polite and clear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Can you tell him that I called?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Of course! I need to speak with him.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am waiting for your call.

scenario.learnerRole: You are speaking to the receptionist.
scenario.brief: Leave a message for Marco, including your number.
scenario.goal: You need to leave a message with your contact details.
